evidenceLevelDefinitions.E1: Owning source or contract exists at the recorded revision.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E2: The named executable test or benchmark passed in its stated scope.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E3: The named build or package step succeeded for the recorded source.

evidenceLevelDefinitions.E5: The installed or current Runtime produced the recorded authoritative event or state.

claimPolicy.deterministicVsJudge: Exact counters, timings, hashes, test outcomes, retrieval metrics, and state transitions remain deterministic fields. AI Judge outputs must be labeled ai_estimate and never replace ground truth.
claimPolicy.proofBoundary: Source, tests, build, install, Runtime, foreground acceptance, and release readiness are independent claims.
claimPolicy.sampleBoundary: Repeated observations improve timing stability but do not increase the number of unique cases.
claimPolicy.snapshotBoundary: A tracked historical receipt may support a revision-qualified interview claim; it does not prove the current dirty worktree or current installed foreground.

inventory.note: Counts describe the current source inventory only; they are not quality or completion metrics.
